go.summary: Short decls, packages, multiple return values, no classes.

go.summary: Static structural interfaces; generics since 1.18; methods stay concrete-first.

python.summary: Exceptions everywhere; EAFP style; context managers for cleanup.

ruby.summary: raise / rescue / ensure; custom StandardError subclasses for domain failures.

ruby.summary: RubyGems + Bundler; Gemfile / Gemfile.lock for apps.
